groups.note: E7 は「너를 위해 피땀을 흘렸는데（あなたのために血と汗を流したのに）」と「치부책（帳面）」を省いた言い回し
食い違い: E45 は「その愛の心は真の家庭から始まる」を「真の家庭への出発点はその愛の心」と向きを逆にしている
diff: The Korean original says the heart of love that treats others as one’s own family and shares with them begins in a true family (English edition reverses the direction: “The starting point toward a true family is the heart of love…”).

groups.note: E52 は「사랑을 주고 또 주는 곳（愛を与えに与える所）」を「receive so much love」としている
diff: The Korean original says the family is the place that gives love and gives again until it overflows (English edition: “where we receive so much love that it overflows”).
